tools.name: check_feature_support
tools.description:
Can I use this feature, and from which browser version?

Accepts a loose name (":has()", "container queries", "css-grid") and resolves it to a caniuse feature, then returns the earliest continuously-supported version per major browser, global usage percentage, and a conservative safe_to_use flag. Us

tools.name: get_feature_by_id
tools.description:
Support table for an exact caniuse feature id.

Use when the id is already known, for example from a previous search. No fuzzy matching is applied.

tools.name: search_features
tools.description:
Find the caniuse feature id for a loose query.

Use when a query is ambiguous and you want to choose between candidates before checking support.
